svg.text: Data Flow Diagram, Level 1 — Owner / Administrator
Figure 4.9 — administrative processes and their data stores
10.0 writes into the same incident table the autonomous detectors use —
an admin-triggered run is indistinguishable downstream from an automatic one.
All ten administrative processes run inside the Nexis control plane; every state change is appended to the audit_log table in the Platform Data store.
